system.description:
You treat a Siang Lance as a Rifle instead of as an Exotic Weapon (Ranged). Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with a Siang Lance. This Talent counts as the Weapon Focus (Siang Lance) feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites.

If you also have the Weapon Focus (Rifles) feat, the attack bonus provided by this Talent does not stack with the attack bonus provided by Weapon Focus (Rifles).

prerequisite.text: a member of The Kilian Rangers
